environment: Node / happy-dom and fake-indexeddb; caret geometry and Chrome capture simulated

tests.name: Link text shows guidance, suppresses link drag/navigation and records the chosen substring
Selection-disabled text is assisted and exact original inline priorities return on Escape
Button labels can be selected without activating the button
Image inside link is not mislabelled text and the alternative records the image
SVG, canvas and empty background targets offer alternatives without claiming OCR
Input, password, textarea, select and editable text do not become original-text records
Dragging across editable content is refused even if both endpoints are ordinary text
Stale selection, right-button release and a click without dragging create no note
Cancelled gestures and window blur cannot leave a stale selection to capture
Area clicks are not recorded; reverse dragging still records the intended rectangle
Repeat-text action waits for saves and records another note under the next code
Failed save keeps the draft panel and blocks changing selection modes
Capture in progress ignores mode changes and Escape; overlay stays hidden until capture completes
Reverse selection across inline markup uses caret positions and preserves original text
Browse/close restores ordinary page actions and preserves newer style edits made by the site
